# CRM Industry Segments & Business Models

| Segment | Typical commercial model | CRM objects and process emphasis |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Export manufacturing | OEM/ODM/OBM, project or order-based production | Account, contact, RFQ, product/BOM, quotation, sample, opportunity, order, shipment and collection |
| Industrial distribution | Manufacturer-to-distributor or channel sales, regional pricing and repeat orders | Account hierarchy, channel partner, price list, quotation version, approval, order and receivables |
| Cross-border B2B | International prospecting, email outreach, meetings and multi-region account management | Lead source, consent, time zone, multilingual activity, opportunity, quotation and customer handoff |
| B2B software and services | Subscription, project, managed service or consulting revenue | Account, stakeholder, opportunity, proposal, renewal, forecast and delivery handoff |
| International logistics | Freight, warehousing, forwarding or supply-chain service contracts | Lane, rate, quote, contract, shipment opportunity, service issue and collection |
